Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work The scope of work includes inspection, servicing, repair and restoration of the following unserviceable equi pment/stores items to full working condition: Ser No| Nomenclature| Qty 1| Wood Cutter| 02 Nos 2| Dryer| 04 Nos

3| Water Cooler| 01 No 4| Pedestal Fan| 05 Nos 5| Paper Shredding Machine| 03 Nos 6| Inverter| 01 No 7| Window AC| 02 Nos 8| Split AC| 01 No 9| Base Station (Motorola)| 01 No 10| Television| 03 Nos 11| Water Dispenser| 05 Nos 2. General Terms and Conditions (a) The service provider shall inspect all equipment and assess the defects before commencing repair wor k. (b) The contractor shall undertake necessary repairs, servicing and replacement of defective components, wherever required, to restore the equipment to full working condition. (c) All spare parts and components required for repair shall be genuine, new and of appropriate quality, co mpatible with the respective equipment. (d) No additional repair work or replacement of major components shall be undertaken without prior appro val of the consignee/authorized representative. (e) The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable charges, including labour, spare parts, transportatio n, loading/unloading, servicing, testing and GST. (f) The contractor shall ensure that the repaired equipment is fully functional and meets the original operat ing specifications. 3. Inspection and Collection of Equipment (a) The service provider shall arrange inspection and collection of equipment from the consignee's premise s, if required. (b) Transportation of equipment to and from the repair workshop shall be the responsibility of the service p rovider. (c) Any damage or loss to the equipment during transportation or repair shall be made good by the service provider at no additional cost. 4. Completion Period The repair and servicing work shall be completed within 10 days from the date of issue of the work order/c ontract. Any delay shall require prior approval from the competent authority. 5. Warranty (a) The service provider shall provide a minimum warranty of 06 months on the repair work and replaced s pare parts from the date of satisfactory completion and acceptance. (b) Any defect arising due to improper repair or defective replacement parts during the warranty period sh all be rectified free of cost. 6. Testing and Acceptance (a) All repaired equipment shall be demonstrated and tested in the presence of the consignee/authorized r epresentative. (b) The equipment shall be accepted only after satisfactory functioning and verification. (c) Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory completion of repair work and certification by the co

nsignee. 7. Payment Terms Payment shall be released on successful completion of the repair work, submission of the invoice and satisfactory performance/acceptance certificate by the consignee, as per applicable Government rules. 8. Non-Performance In case the service provider fails to complete the repair work within the stipulated period or fails to restore the equipment to satisfactory working condition, appropriate action shall be taken as per the terms and c onditions of the GeM contract and applicable Government rules. 9. Other Conditions (a) The service provider shall maintain proper care and custody of all equipment handed over for repair. (b) The service provider shall not use any refurbished, used or substandard spare parts without prior writt en approval. (c) The service provider shall comply with all applicable Government rules, regulations and GeM terms and conditions. (d) The decision of the competent authority regarding satisfactory completion and acceptance of repair wo rk shall be final, subject to applicable rules. 10. Place of Service Repair and servicing shall be carried out at the consignee's premises or at the service provider's workshop , as decided by the consignee depending upon the nature of the equipment and repair requirement. 11 PRE-BID SITE INSPECTION (MANDATORY) (a) All prospective bidders shall mandatorily visit the consignee's premises and physically inspect/check all the equipment/items listed in the bid before opening of the Technical Bid. (b) The bidder shall assess the actual condition of the equipment, nature of defects, repair requirements a nd feasibility of undertaking the repair work before submitting the bid. (c) The bidder shall submit a duly signed Site Inspection Certificate, countersigned by the consignee/autho rized representative, along with the Technical Bid as proof of successful inspection. (d) The bidder shall be solely responsible for assessing the scope and cost of repair before quoting the rate s. No claim for additional payment on account of non-inspection or incorrect assessment shall be entertain ed. (e) Any bidder who fails to carry out the mandatory site inspection or fails to submit the duly signed Site In spection Certificate along with the Technical Bid shall be treated as non-compliant and shall be liable for di squalification during technical evaluation, subject to applicable GeM terms and procurement rules. .
